flow: guided patch-first: read agent + supplied rationale, then patch-data alone (no pack-html), validate, snapshot
commands_run: clan patch-data h1-clan/work/doc.clan h1-clan/receipts/hop07-output/patch-data.json --agent verdict-flip --action "Flip verdict HubSpot->Zoho CRM; set verdict_rationale" --quiet

errors.what: patch-data refused: change needs attribution (--agent/--action required)
errors.recovered_by: re-ran with --agent verdict-flip --action and a JSON patch file

problems_and_friction: Both target fields are data-bound, so patch-data alone sufficed and pack-html stayed untouched. The only friction was the mandatory attribution flags on first invocation, resolved in one retry.
context_understood: Flip the data-bound verdict from HubSpot to Zoho CRM and set verdict_rationale to the supplied text, using patch-data only (pack-html forbidden) since the HTML reads both via {{key}} bindings.
